pages.text: A furnace built $(item)entirely from reinforced blocks$() works twice as fast.
$(li)$(item)Corners$(): Blast Furnace Reinforcement (rusted works too) or Blocks of Steel.$(li)$(item)Edges$(): Reinforced Fireproof Bricks or Blocks of Steel. The hatch counts as reinforced.

$(l)Making reinforced bricks$()$(br)Build the edge as Fireproof Bricks, then place a $(item)Blast Furnace Reinforcement against its outer face$(). It becomes a thin plate and turns the brick behind it into Reinforced Fireproof Bricks. Removing the plate turns it back.

Because of that, a reinforcement placed against the side of a fireproof brick always becomes a plate. Place the $(item)corner$() blocks first, or on top of the corner below, never by clicking a neighbouring brick.
One regular block anywhere in the walls makes the whole furnace regular. The output and the bottom centre do not count. The goggles show $(item)Reinforced$() when it worked.
The block list under the view skips the bricks and plates: add 10 Fireproof Bricks and 10 Blast Furnace Reinforcements.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
